intent.core: The first snow of the year starts falling while someone waits on an outdoor train platform, and the small surprise of it loosens a worry they have been carrying all day.
intent.scene: Late afternoon, an open-air suburban platform. The train is a few minutes late. The first flakes land on a coat sleeve and melt.
intent.emotional_color: Quiet relief with a little wonder in it. It must not turn into big sentimental release or Christmas cheer.
intent.dramatic_motion: From head-down waiting and replaying the day, to looking up and noticing the snow, to a small private smile as the train arrives.
intent.perspective: First person, speaking to themselves under their breath.
intent.listener_question: Can I hear the moment the singer looks up from the worry to the snow, without the song telling me in words that they feel better?

arrangement_hints: bass and a light kit enter only after the look-up moment
must_avoid: sleigh bells or other Christmas signifiers
a final big chorus or key change
the word for happiness in the lyrics
